label: Bible Study
prompt: Rejoiceth not in _____, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verse: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
note: Love doesn't enjoy anyone's downfall — it celebrates what's true.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus, moved with _____, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verse: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
note: A leper said 'if thou wilt' — Jesus, moved with compassion, touched the untouchable and said 'I will.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his _____. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verse: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
note: God spoke with Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend — while young Joshua never left the tent.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I am like a _____ of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verse: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
note: A lonely sufferer compares himself to a bird of the wasteland — the next line adds an owl in the desert.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth _____.
verse: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
note: The watchman recognized Jehu by his driving: 'he driveth furiously' — Scripture's most famous chariot speeder.
